rca of the issue: Original bug: partners_portal computed reimbursed_total as sum(reimbursement.amount); a user could create both a manual (no-link) reimbursement AND a linked one for the same expense, causing the loan amount to be subtracted twice and outstanding to go negative / appear duplicated. Fix verified: (a) reimbursed_total is now sum(personal_expense.amount where expense.id in any reimbursement.source_transaction_ids) — manual reimbursements with empty source_transaction_ids no longer reduce outstanding; (b) double-link prevented at API with 409 + 'ya fue reembolsado' detail; (c) cross-partner and missing-tx linking also 409; (d) cash_reimbursed_total kept as sum(reimbursement.amount) for the cash-out widget; (e) deleting a still-pending personal expense returns 409. Frontend mirror: manual-confirm-checkbox forces explicit confirmation when there are pending unselected loans, and delete button is disabled (cursor-not-allowed/slate-300) on pending rows. Reproduction would have required creating manual + linked rb for same tx; with new validation this is now impossible.
